title: Smoothness descends along a flat morphism of schemes locally of finite type over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X to Y of schemes locally of finite type over k, if X over k is smooth at a point x and f is flat there, the lemma concludes that Y over k is smooth at the image point, with the global statement following when f is flat and surjective (statement lines 4756-4763). The proof reduces smoothness to geometric regularity: it suffices to show that Y is geometrically regular at the image point, by the equivalence between the two notions at a point over a field, and that conclusion follows from the flat descent of geometric regularity applied to the given point together with the same equivalence now used at x on X (proof lines 4765-4772). The claim is H2: a two-step reduction through the smooth-regular equivalence, with the descent lemma doing the work and no step referred to the reader.
